title: DkimConfig type duplicated validation logic across smtp and reader crates
description: The DKIM config validation block (empty domain, empty selector, secretx bypass, base64 decode, 32-byte length check for seed, 32-byte length check for pubkey) is copy-pasted identically in smtp/src/config.rs and reader/src/config.rs. DkimConfig itself lives in smtp/src/config.rs and is re-used by reader. Any change to validation rules (e.g. adding a minimum selector length check, or validating that pubkey matches seed) must be made in two places. When it isn't, the two binaries will silently diverge in what config they accept. Fix: add a validate() method on DkimConfig itself, call it from both callers.
